description: This file contains the implementation of the AmqpClientActor class, which manages an AMQP 1.0 connection using the Qpid JMS client. It handles connection lifecycle, session recovery, publisher and consumer resource management, and reacts to JMS and connection events within an Akka actor framework.

classes.name: AmqpClientActor
classes.description: Actor managing an AMQP 1.0 connection with session recovery, resource management, and event handling.

classes.name: JmsConnect
classes.description: Message to initiate a JMS connection.

classes.name: JmsRecoverSession
classes.description: Message to recover a JMS session.

classes.name: JmsCloseSession
classes.description: Message to close a JMS session.

classes.name: StatusReportingListener
classes.description: Listener that monitors JMS connection events and reports status without changing actor state.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates actor props with connection and optional proxy and connection actor references.

methods.name: propsForTests
methods.description: Creates actor props for testing with injected dependencies.

methods.name: validateConnection
methods.description: Validates connection configuration by attempting to create a provider.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Ensures closing of JMS connection when actor stops.

methods.name: inConnectedState
methods.description: Defines behavior in the connected state, particularly session recovery events.

methods.name: inAnyState
methods.description: Defines event handlers for connection, session, consumer, and producer status updates.

methods.name: doTestConnection
methods.description: Performs test connection by delegating to a child actor and handling response.

methods.name: doConnectClient
methods.description: Delegates connection command to a handler actor.

methods.name: doDisconnectClient
methods.description: Delegates disconnection command to a handler actor.

methods.name: allocateResourcesOnConnection
methods.description: Stores JMS connection and session upon successful connection.

methods.name: startPublisherActor
methods.description: Initializes publisher actor responsible for publishing messages.

methods.name: startConsumerActors
methods.description: Starts consumer actors for subscribed sources.

methods.name: cleanupResourcesForConnection
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as consumers, publisher, and JMS connection.

methods.name: cleanupFurtherResourcesOnConnectionTimeout
methods.description: Kills connection handler actors on timeout to prepare for next operations.

methods.name: isEventUpToDate
methods.description: Determines if an event is relevant based on current state and sender.

methods.name: getPublisherActor
methods.description: Returns the actor responsible for publishing messages.

methods.name: startCommandConsumers
methods.description: Starts consumer actors for each subscription.

methods.name: startCommandConsumer
methods.description: Starts an individual consumer actor for a given subscription.

methods.name: stopCommandConsumers
methods.description: Stops all active consumer actors.

methods.name: getTestConnectionHandler
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the test connection handler actor.

methods.name: getConnectConnectionHandler
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the connect handler actor.

methods.name: getDisconnectConnectionHandler
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the disconnect handler actor.

methods.name: startConnectionHandlingActor
methods.description: Creates and starts a connection handling actor with a specific role (connect/disconnect/test).

methods.name: ensureJmsConnectionClosed
methods.description: Closes JMS connection asynchronously to avoid blocking.

methods.name: recoverSession
methods.description: Attempts recovery of a closed or broken JMS session.
